name: knee-to-chest-single-leg-glute-bridge
instructions:
1. Setup in a supine position with your knees bent and hands by your sides.
2. Pull one knee to your chest and hold it.
3. Bridge the hips up by driving your down foot into the floor.
4. Slowly lower back to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.
starting_position: 1. Setup in a supine position with your knees bent and hands by your sides. 2. Pull one knee to your chest and hold it.
